title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Lee Hodges' Strong John Deere Start
items.text: Lee Hodges opened the John Deere Classic with a bogey-free 7-under 64, signaling a bounce back after a long slump marked by a cracked rib and missed cuts.

items.headline: PGA Tour to Revamp Eligibility
items.text: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp announced plans to streamline the 2028 priority system from 48 to about 12 categories, prioritizing current performance and future potential over legacy exemptions.

items.headline: DeChambeau Faces Challenging Return Options
items.text: With a likely one-year PGA Tour ban if LIV Golf folds, Bryson DeChambeau may have to compete in the new Challenger Series or seek the DP World Tour route to return to the top tier.
